title: Right-of-reply submission
intro: For a named benchmark subject (a rail operator) to respond to a published result. Structured, publisher-controlled, and not a public comment surface. File a separate form for each axis.

fields.label: Authorised-signatory confirmation (must be on the rail's published authorised-signatory list)
Exact passage, chart, or row challenged (300 words or fewer)
Axis (tick ONE; file separate forms for separate axes)
Statement of grounds (500 words or fewer)
Evidence (URLs, hashes, on-chain references; PDFs 25 MB or smaller)
Requested remedy (correction, re-run, annotated reply, or withdrawal)
Public reply text to publish verbatim (500 words or fewer; markdown allowed; no scripts or images larger than 1 MB)
Good-faith declaration: I confirm the information above is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge. Signed, dated.
Consent to publication of the rail name, challenged passage, axis, requested remedy, and public reply text.
